description: This script generates a build stamp file indicating the build time and current git commit hash. It provides functions to resolve the current Git HEAD commit and write a timestamped build stamp into a JSON file in the dist directory. When executed directly, it automatically writes the build stamp.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Resolves the current git HEAD commit hash by running 'git rev-parse HEAD'. Returns null if the command fails or no hash is found.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates the 'dist/.buildstamp' file containing the build timestamp and git hash, creating directories if necessary.
